name: Made in Asia
blurb: Belgian festival for manga, anime, Asian pop culture, YouTubers and cosplay, run by Easyfairs in Brussels.
notes: The given place (Mons, BE / Lotto Mons Expo) is wrong: Made in Asia runs at Brussels Expo, not Mons — no mention of Mons appears anywhere on the live site. Made in Asia is a twice-a-year Easyfairs brand, but the two editions are no longer alike: (1) Made in Asia Spring ran independently Feb 27–Mar 1, 2026 at Brussels Expo — already over as of this 2026-10-05 check, and the site's own /en/edition/made-in-asia-spring-2027/ link currently just redirects to the homepage, so no Spring 2027 dates are announced yet; (2) Made in Asia Fall is no longer an independent event — Easyfairs merged it with Heroes Comic Con and GameForce into one combined show, 'Heroes World', for Oct 17–18, 2026 at Brussels Expo (one ticket, shared site); that merged edition and its guests are recorded under this batch's separate 'heroes-world' entry instead of here, to avoid duplicating the same edition under two ids. Leaving editions empty here rather than duplicating Heroes World's dates/guests under the Made in Asia brand too.
